dedupe_keys.name: fano pesaro offshore borehole stratigraphy and geophysical logs

description: The Zenodo release collects digitized stratigraphic and geophysical information from seven hydrocarbon-exploration boreholes in the offshore Pesaro–Fano area of the Adriatic Sea. The wells date from the 1980s, and the authors digitized detailed geophysical logs for Boheme 01 and Tamara 01. The public record exposes one approximately 140 MB ZIP and states CC BY 4.0. Such subsurface observations can constrain coastal or offshore pipeline, port and seismic-site simulations where regional geology matters. It complements data-efehr-eshm20-european-seismic-hazard-model by providing local subsurface evidence beneath a broader seismic-hazard context. The logs are historical exploration evidence, not a complete geotechnical characterization for construction or a direct measure of seismic fragility. Original paper scans are at Italy's VIDEPI archive, and the Zenodo description says scalable SVG stratigraphic columns are available on request. The ZIP contents and exact machine-readable fields were not inspected, so this draft covers only the verified public package and leaves completeness uncertain. No archive was downloaded.
